rationale.conclusive_coverage_min: the task requires a significant improvement of the Pilot's deterministic-verdict coverage (baseline 120/288 = 0.417); 0.55 is a fixed, pre-declared floor
rationale.timeout_fraction_max: the Pilot baseline is 0.556 right-censored; 0.40 is the pre-declared ceiling for accepting the optimised design
rationale.expected_compute_minutes_max: censoring-aware expectation for the 8,280-cell matrix must stay below 3,000 runner-minutes (50 h) so a 20-way GitHub run stays inside the platform's resource envelope
rationale.rss_p95_mib_max: standard ubuntu-22.04 runners have 16 GiB; 2 GiB P95 leaves a large margin and covers the instrumented expansion caches
rationale.formal_plan: 120 shards x 69 tasks, 60 s cell cap, 150 min job cap, max-parallel 20, standard hosted runners only - the same shape as the audited v5 formal run
